parent_objective: run source-history corpus expansion plan on the M1330 merged source export
blocked_by: M1330 exports a merged source corpus candidate that needs fold planning before materialization
supersedes: source-history materialization from M1322 or M1327 alone

public_gates: M1331 must not use private holdout
M1331 must preserve actor input contract
M1331 must use the M1330 merged export
M1331 must not count stale materialized histories
M1331 must report global friction and halfshaft coverage gaps
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use stale M1280 materialized history by pair id
do not hide global friction gap
do not route directly to PPO

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: plans the M1330 merged source export into source-history folds before materialization
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: planning infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if plan uses stale materialized histories
stop if plan hides global friction or halfshaft gaps
stop if plan routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if plan is admissible, route to source-history materialization design
if plan is under target, route to merge/export result audit
if fold balance regresses, route to family-balanced export repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1330 exports merged source corpus candidate

admission_evidence: global friction remains missing and halfshaft undercovered
blocked_shortcuts: do not materialize histories before plan result audit
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: planned pair-probe group count is reported
global friction and halfshaft gaps are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1331 plans source rows and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: plan merged source rows for later command-response history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If merged plan remains under target, report the gap rather than materializing or training anyway.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1330 merged source export can support an admissible source-history corpus expansion plan without stale materialized-history matches.
success_criteria: global friction and halfshaft coverage gaps are reported
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: target source pairs or groups are under target without clear blocker
folds are empty or pair-disjointness is violated
global friction or halfshaft gaps are hidden
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1331 passes as infrastructure if it plans the M1330 merged source export into pair-disjoint folds and reports coverage gaps without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, materialization, or actor-input expansion.
